data.title: 摩根 · 雨之魔女森林
data.description: 【摩根 · 雨之魔女森林】细雨初歇的妖精森林里，年轻的梣披着蓝袍提着法杖走过湿润的苔径，兜帽下的银发沾着水珠，眼神温柔而辽远——「雨会停，而路还很长。」
data.action: 雨停后披蓝色兜帽袍持木杖走过湿苔路径，另一手提稳袍摆
data.camera: full-body side view, walking boots and wet moss path visible
data.promptProse: Aesc walks the wet moss path, staff in one hand and robe hem lifted with the other. Soft light catches rain on her silver hair.
data.animaCaption: One hand holds the staff while the other lifts the robe hem.
